title: Riffle head commit features
description: Code features of each head commit a PR had while open, captured during mining (snapshot_capture.py) for the PRs snapshots are built for: up to snapshot_max_heads per PR. Feature columns are null on the at-open head, whose features are in the mined row, and on a head that failed (error).

repo.description: Row metadata or Source 4c PR metadata. Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/mine_repo.py`.

pr_number.description: Row metadata or Source 4c PR metadata. Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/mine_repo.py`.

head_sha.description: A head commit the PR had while it was open

base_sha.description: Its fork point from the base branch; the code features are base...head

first_seen.description: When this commit became the PR's head (commit time standing in for push time)

at_open.description: The at-open head; its features are the mined row's, not repeated here

error.description: Why the features couldn't be computed, if they couldn't

Entropy.description: Source 4a/4b diff and paths. Computed in `pipelines/ingestion/repo_miner/features/diff_stats.py`.
